text:
Pitu pila in a tree. There is a snake going to eat pitu pila in a tree and you have to dodge it. make it faster as you level up by dodging 10.  Pitu pila is green, snake is red.

(Dim tip: LEDs are on/off only; to dim, blink fast with millis() in gameTick().)

Pitu Pila (green) sits in the tree. When a light blinks red, the snake is about to bite there, so tap another light to hop Pitu away! Every 10 dodges you level up and the snake gets faster. 🐍🌳

When the snake catches Pitu, the board flashes red. Then the yellow lights show what level you got to, and a new game starts by itself. Good luck! 🍀
